rows.label: qst200221_msg0001
rows.name:
Finally found you. You
are Harhal, right?!

rows.label: qst200221_msg0002
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Who are you?
New people from my supplier?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0003
rows.name:
No! I'm an ally of justice,
and I'm here to save you!

rows.label: qst200221_msg0005
rows.name:
I know all about you! Why did you get
involved in smuggling Pollen Orbs?!

rows.label: qst200221_msg0007
rows.name: What's wrong? Why are you silent?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0009
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Why are you looking away?
Are you hiding something else?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0012
rows.name:
Hmm[ML:Dash ] It appears you're using
Pollen Orbs to make something,
are you not?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0013
rows.name:
What does this mean, Harhal? Are
you not smuggling Pollen Orbs!?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0014
rows.name: What on earth are you hiding!?

rows.label: qst200221_msg0017
rows.name: In that case, I'll get serious too!!
